newsitem.title: USA: Ariz. Palo Verde nuke unit 1 reaches full power.
newsitem.headline: Ariz. Palo Verde nuke unit 1 reaches full power.

text.p: Arizona Public Service Co's 1,221 megawatt Palo Verde nuclear power unit 1 was operating at full capacity Thursday morning, returning from scheduled maintenance, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
The Wintersburg, Ariz., unit was operating at 100 percent output as of early Thursday from about 78 percent of capacity early Wednesday, the NRC said in its daily plant status report.
The unit was shut Sept 21 for scheduled refueling and maintenance, and began to ramp up power on Nov 1.
Palo Verde's other two 1,221 megawatt units were also operating at full capacity Thursday, the NRC said.
